short_title: Survey table: enhance, then isolate one row
paper_query: Which organization conducted the survey in 2020?

paper_steps.observation: The low-contrast table text becomes easier to read.
The row reads: 2020 · 72% · Public Policy Polling.

why: 调用链最干净：原表 → 对比度增强 → 目标行裁剪；问题和答案都短，适合在小版面讲清证据获取。
caveat: 黑白表格的视觉冲击力弱于彩色图表。
question: Which organization conducted the survey in 2020?

short_title: Sunburst chart: inspect multiple dense regions
paper_query: What is the combined share of the top product in each of the three largest categories?

paper_steps.observation: The largest Produce item is Leafy Greens at 9%.
Free-range Chicken is 4%; a separate Dairy crop finds Greek Yogurt at 6%.

why: 色彩丰富且“整图 → 局部证据”的视觉关系非常直观；三次真实 crop 均保留在 media/。
caveat: 两个展示 crop 是并列读取；教师思考还指出图中一个子项小计不完全一致，因此若强调数值严谨性优先选 A1。
question: What is the combined absolute market share of the most prominent product in each of the three largest product categories?

short_title: Chart dashboard: acquire evidence from two subplots
paper_query: How large is the monthly-to-yearly CS increase relative to average History enrollment?

paper_steps.observation: Monthly averages: CS 76.67; History 58.33.
Yearly CS average is 79.5; the normalized increase is 0.0486.

why: 能体现工具在多子图中分别获取证据，再进行数值计算的模式。
caveat: “average History enrollment”被教师解释为 monthly History，语义有歧义；不建议作为首选。
question: What fraction of the average History enrollment level does the average increase in Computer Science enrollment represent when comparing monthly to yearly trends?

short_title: Social metrics table: compare two distant rows
paper_query: Were Twitter retweets more numerous than Facebook posts?

paper_steps.observation: Twitter Retweets = 800.
Facebook Posts = 400.

why: 问题简单，两个 crop 分别提供比较所需的数值，读者无需理解复杂背景。
caveat: 两次 crop 为并列证据，不含额外视觉变换。
question: True or False: There were more retweets than posts on Facebook.

short_title: Calendar GUI: localize and click “Edit Details…”
paper_query: Click “Edit Details…” in the calendar event dialog.

paper_steps.observation: The target button becomes legible in the dialog.
The verified target center is [353, 453].

why: 标准且完整的 crop → draw_bbox → computer_use 轨迹；目标按钮语义明确，截图干净。
caveat: 最终 bbox 在全图中较小，排版时建议使用 crop 与 bbox 的局部视图。
question: Click on the "Edit Details..." button to access the detailed event configuration settings where the date, time, reminders, and notes can be properly configured.

short_title: Visual search: two-stage zoom to read a scarf
paper_query: What text appears on the dog’s scarf?

paper_steps.observation: The dog and its blue checkered scarf become visible.
The red label resolves into readable white text.

why: 从大场景到狗再到项圈文字的两级嵌套 crop 非常直观，缩略图下仍能看出证据逐步显现。
caveat: 最终标签文字带有幽默色彩，论文风格是否合适可人工决定。
question: What does it say on the scarf around the dog's neck in the lower middle of the picture?

short_title: Visual search: zoom and mark four tea cups
paper_query: How many white tea cups are on the coffee table?

paper_steps.observation: The tea tray is isolated at a readable scale.
Four separate cups are marked on the tray.

why: 最终证据图用四色 bbox 标出四个杯子，工具结果的用途一眼可见。
caveat: 完整轨迹有两次 crop，三联画跳过了第一层较宽的 crop；该图仍保留在 media/。
question: How many white tea cups are there on the coffee table?

short_title: Writer GUI: localize the center-alignment button
paper_query: Click the center-alignment button in the formatting toolbar.

paper_steps.observation: The four alignment icons become distinguishable.
The verified center-align icon is at [768, 183].

why: 真实桌面应用、目标图标清楚，同样覆盖 crop → bbox → click 的典型模式。
caveat: 全图中的最终 bbox 很小，需在正式图中放大局部。
question: Click on the center alignment button in the formatting toolbar to center the text in the document.

short_title: Visual search: localize and count six bottles
paper_query: How many mineral-water bottles are on the mini-bar counter?

paper_steps.observation: A compact group of red-capped bottles is isolated.
Six individual bottles are marked.

why: crop 后的目标组清楚，最终六个红框很醒目；比纯文字读取更能体现定位工具。
caveat: 场景色调偏浅，正式排版时需要保证打印对比度。
question: How many bottles of mineral water are there on the mini bar counter on the left side of the center of the picture?

short_title: Tech-company page: repair a narrow first render
paper_query: Recreate the reference tech-company webpage in HTML and CSS.

paper_steps.observation: Oversized product/footer placeholders make the first render narrow and overlong.
Revisions remove product images and reduce the icons and logo.

why: 初稿错误非常明显（页面被压成窄列），修订后恢复为接近参考图的横向布局；小尺寸也看得出变化。
caveat: 完整轨迹有三次 render；三联画只展示第一次与最后一次。

short_title: Grouped bars: isolate one year across all countries
paper_query: In 2021, what fraction of total funding equals the amount by which the U.S. exceeded China?

paper_steps.observation: Ten clean yellow bars are isolated; their bounding boxes provide the 2021 heights.

why: 单次颜色调用、输出最干净，黄色年度序列与问题直接对应；即使缩到论文尺寸也能看出十根柱子。
caveat: 只有一个关键视觉 observation；后续两次 exec 只是把 bbox 高度换算并求比例。
question: What fraction of the total funding allocated in 2021 for international anti-corruption initiatives was the amount by which the United States' contribution exceeded China's contribution?

short_title: Stacked bars: split caloric levels by color
paper_query: What is the average ratio of high-calorie consumption to combined low- and moderate-calorie consumption?

paper_steps.observation: The low-calorie segment of every food-category bar is isolated.
The high-calorie segments are isolated; a third real call extracts the moderate segments.

why: 最典型的堆叠柱颜色分解：三次真实 HSV 调用分别取得 Low、Moderate、High，颜色掩膜与数值计算关系直观。
caveat: 三联主卡只放 Low 与 High；Moderate 的真实输出保留在 media/ 和完整记录中。
question: What is the average ratio of high-calorie consumption to combined low and moderate-calorie consumption across all food categories?

short_title: Grouped bars: separate three genres before comparison
paper_query: What is the ratio of Children's Books growth to the combined growth of Poetry and Academic Texts?

paper_steps.observation: Ten Children's Books bars are isolated, exposing the 2013 and 2022 endpoints.
Academic Texts are isolated; a third real call similarly extracts Poetry.

why: 三种颜色序列都得到规整的十根柱，能清楚体现“分离序列 → 比较首尾增长 → 计算答案”。
caveat: 主卡省略 Poetry mask，但全部三次调用及输出都保留在 media/。
question: What is the ratio of the total growth in children's book publications from 2013 to 2022 to the combined total growth of poetry and academic book publications over the same period?

short_title: Sunburst: isolate the dominant hierarchy by color
paper_query: Within the most prevalent main category, what share does one specific business type typically occupy?

paper_steps.observation: The complete blue Retail hierarchy is separated from the other main categories.
Six leaf shares are readable: 9%, 6%, 7%, 5%, 6%, and 4%.

why: 非柱状图案例且调用链只有两步，能展示颜色工具也可用于层级图中的语义区域隔离。
caveat: 问题表述略抽象；最终数值还需要在 crop 中读取叶节点标签。
question: What is the typical share of the total business landscape occupied by a single specific business type within the most prevalent main business category?

short_title: Stacked trend: measure one component of total growth
paper_query: What percentage of the total bug increase from Oct. 2022 to Mar. 2023 was caused by Chrome?

paper_steps.observation: Chrome segments are isolated across all dates; endpoint heights correspond to about 95 and 235 bugs.
Top segments provide full-bar anchors for the labeled totals 190 and 497.

why: 两个颜色 observation 都很干净，且直接支撑“局部增长占总增长比例”的像素测量。
caveat: 完整调用链含 enhance/crop 和脚本计算；结果是基于像素高度的近似值。
question: What percentage of the total increase in web compatibility bugs observed from October 1, 2022, to March 1, 2023, was specifically caused by Chrome browser issues?
